development_failures.reason: The c=0.3 optical-volume sample still has a 9.48e-8 two-species finite-volume correction, larger than the proposed test tolerance.
development_failures.resolution: Retained c=0.3 and added c=0.15 to the same convergence sequence. No finite-volume uniform-in-n claim is made.

development_failures.reason: The finite-mesh Matsubara truncation omitted its constant high-frequency delta-K tail.
development_failures.resolution: Summed the constant tail analytically and bounded the remaining inverse-fourth-power tail; kept the common mesh contact cancellation.

accepted_scope: Fixed-background spherical electric LLL Hamiltonian with radial Gauss profile, neutral inner flux and integer species lattice.
Exact finite-interval Euclidean boundary two-point ratio, with screened charge energy and its oscillator displacement derived together.
Half-line limit in the specified ensemble and the inherited candidate initial-electric-loss bound, conditional on that physical matching.
limitations: No physical creation or full stability claim
Optical-volume limit is at fixed finite species number, not a finite-volume certificate uniform in n.
Four-dimensional microscopic boundary matching and gravitational charge-sector measure remain open.
novelty: No exhaustive novelty review or novelty acceptance; bosonization, theta functions and Gaussian diagonalization are established tools.
